decisions.action: Retain existing sorghum-bicolor species card and authorship; do not infer cultivated subspecies from photographs.
Retain separate Johnsongrass concept; authorship (L.) Pers. is verified although current species.json omits authority field. No canonical write in taxonomy-only lane.

decisions.rank: species with two subspecies and one nothosubspecies
decisions.action: Recognize subsp. bicolor, subsp. verticilliflorum, and nothosubsp. drummondii as distinct accepted infraspecific concepts under S. bicolor. Do not assign existing crop/shattercane photographs to any subspecies without independent evidence.

decisions.accepted_name: Sorghum bicolor nothosubsp. drummondii (Nees ex Steud.) de Wet ex Davidse
decisions.action: POWO parent formula S. bicolor subsp. bicolor × S. bicolor subsp. verticilliflorum. Historic S. × drummondii is a synonym; no third learner card and no identification of existing shattercane photos as this hybrid.

decisions.source_name: Sorghum × drummondii (Nees ex Steud.) Millsp. & Chase
decisions.accepted_name: Sorghum bicolor nothosubsp. drummondii (Nees ex Steud.) de Wet ex Davidse
decisions.rank: historical named hybrid at species rank
decisions.action: Preserve searchable historical alias and × sign; do not treat as S. halepense or separate approved learner species.

decisions.rank: historical named hybrid at species rank
decisions.action: Sudangrass alias maps to the accepted nothosubspecies under POWO; do not infer parentage for a specific field observation.

decisions.accepted_name: Sorghum bicolor nothosubsp. drummondii (Nees ex Steud.) de Wet ex Davidse
decisions.action: Despite halepense in its historical combination, map this exact name to bicolor nothosubsp. drummondii, not to Johnsongrass.
Historical halepense combination resolves to cultivated S. bicolor subsp. bicolor under POWO; do not merge into S. halepense.
Name belongs to Hemisorghum mekongense under POWO, not to Johnsongrass. Record historical boundary only; no unrelated taxon installation or review.
Keep as historical alias of Johnsongrass; no new variety card.

POWO gives parentage S. bicolor × S. halepense. Distinct from accepted Johnsongrass and distinct from S. bicolor nothosubsp. drummondii. Do not create a new card or assign this hybrid to existing photos.

decisions.source_name: Historical evolutionary hybrid origin of Sorghum halepense
decisions.rank: accepted species with ancient hybrid ancestry
decisions.action: Paterson et al. (2020) document S. bicolor × S. propinquum origin and introgression. Ancient ancestry does NOT rename S. halepense as S. × almum and cannot establish parentage of any individual Texas specimen.

conflict_and_hold_summary.johnsongrass_ancient_hybrid_origin: Documented primary genomic study; distinct from modern artificial S. × almum

handoff: Two canonical Poaceae species retain accepted names; preserve accepted rank distinctions of bicolor subsp. bicolor, subsp. verticilliflorum, and nothosubsp. drummondii. Sudan grass historical names may misleadingly contain halepense yet resolve to bicolor hybrid concept. Sorghum × almum is a separate named artificial bicolor × halepense hybrid, not an automatic identification of any learner photo. No installation, card enrichment, genus/family, photo, county range or Pages changes.
